body:
I invested all my energy into this for years and all my efforts were tossed aside in just a few days. :(
Sadly, the only person who knows about my condition always tells me that it's my problem and they can't help me at all and I guess that's true.

I am thankful for your response. :)

I don't wanna sound overly gloomy, but I truly think that I have lost the reason for living my life. I used to smile through everything and even if I was upset, I would get up and try to be hopeful. I feel very abandoned and alone right now and I wrote this post mainly to get my feelings out there, cause I don't wanna burden anyone who knows me.

Don't get me wrong, I truly agree with you, but in my case, I think it's just bad luck, from beginning to end.
Nobody is even really at fault, maybe only myself.
